items.name: nostalgia-theme
items.title: Nostalgia Theme
items.description: Mac OS 9 design tokens (--os9-* colors, bevel shadows, heading font) and utilities (os9-raised, os9-inset, os9-window, os9-stripes, os9-focus-ring). Required by every retro-* component.

@utility os9-stripes.background-image: repeating-linear-gradient(to bottom, transparent, transparent 1px, var(--os9-gray-600) 1px, var(--os9-gray-600) 2px)

items.name: retro-label
items.title: RetroLabel
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled label with Geneva 10pt default and Charcoal 12pt large size variants, built on Radix UI Label.

items.name: retro-button
items.title: RetroButton
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled button with raised bevel effect, active/pressed state, and disabled styling.

items.name: retro-input
items.title: RetroInput
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled text input with inset bevel effect, focus ring, and two sizes.

items.name: retro-radio
items.title: RetroRadio
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled radio button group with 3D circular bevel effect, built on Radix UI Radio Group.

items.name: retro-tabs
items.title: RetroTabs
items.description: Mac OS 9 styled tabs with large/small sizes and raised bevel active state, built on Radix UI Tabs.

items.name: retro-progress
items.title: RetroProgress
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled progress bar with inset bevel track and candy-stripe azul fill pattern.

items.name: retro-title-bar
items.title: RetroTitleBar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled title bar with striped drag region, close/collapse/zoom control boxes, and centered title text.

items.name: retro-slider
items.title: RetroSlider
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled slider with rectangular raised bevel thumb and inset track, built on Radix UI Slider.

items.name: retro-checkbox
items.title: RetroCheckbox
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled checkbox with inset bevel effect, inline SVG checkmark, and active/disabled states.

items.name: retro-menu-bar
items.title: RetroMenuBar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled menu bar with horizontal strip, bevel highlights, azul active state, and dropdown menus with classic drop shadow.

items.name: retro-window
items.title: RetroWindow
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled window frame with title bar, close/collapse/zoom controls, active/inactive states, and content area.

items.name: retro-select
items.title: RetroSelect
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled select dropdown with raised bevel trigger, up/down chevron arrows, and azul-highlighted menu items, built on Radix UI Select.

items.name: retro-separator
items.title: RetroSeparator
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled separator with classic beveled line effect: dark top/left pixel and light bottom/right pixel, built on Radix UI Separator.

items.name: retro-textarea
items.title: RetroTextarea
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled textarea with inset bevel effect, focus ring, vertical resize, and two sizes.

items.name: retro-badge
items.title: RetroBadge
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled badge with raised bevel effect, Geneva 9px font, and three color variants: default, accent (lavender), and azul.

items.name: retro-popover
items.title: RetroPopover
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled popover with classic drop shadow, built on Radix UI Popover.

items.name: retro-toggle
items.title: RetroToggle
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled toggle button with raised/pressed bevel states, built on Radix UI Toggle.

items.name: retro-card
items.title: RetroCard
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled card with raised bevel effect, header with bevel separator, title, description, content area, and footer with action buttons.

items.name: retro-switch
items.title: RetroSwitch
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled binary toggle switch with rectangular inset track, raised bevel thumb, and azul checked state, built on Radix UI Switch.

items.name: retro-tooltip
items.title: RetroTooltip
items.description: A Mac OS 9 Balloon Help styled tooltip with pale yellow background, rounded corners, and drop shadow, built on Radix UI Tooltip.

items.name: retro-hover-card
items.title: RetroHoverCard
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled hover card with solid border and drop shadow, built on Radix UI Hover Card.

items.name: retro-alert
items.title: RetroAlert
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled alert box with raised bevel effect, left accent border, and three variants: default, warning, and destructive.

items.name: retro-pagination
items.title: RetroPagination
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled pagination component with raised bevel page buttons, active/pressed state, previous/next navigation, and ellipsis indicator.

items.name: retro-avatar
items.title: RetroAvatar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled avatar with beveled border, image support, fallback initials, and sm/default/lg size variants, built on Radix UI Avatar.

items.name: retro-skeleton
items.title: RetroSkeleton
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled skeleton loading placeholder with dithered diagonal hatching pattern and optional pulse animation.

items.name: retro-chevron
items.title: RetroChevron
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled chevron arrow (filled triangle) with configurable direction, two color variants, and two sizes.

items.name: retro-breadcrumb
items.title: RetroBreadcrumb
items.description: A Mac OS 9 Finder-style breadcrumb navigation with Geneva 10px text, azul links, right-pointing triangle separators, and ellipsis for collapsed paths.

items.name: retro-toast
items.title: RetroToast
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled custom toast system with mini-window appearance, striped title bar, beveled close box, and auto-dismiss via useRetroToast hook.

items.name: retro-nav-button
items.title: RetroNavButton
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled 16x16 navigation button with raised bevel, centered SVG arrow, and four directions: left, right, up, down.

items.name: retro-context-menu
items.title: RetroContextMenu
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled context menu with right-click trigger, sub-menus, checkbox/radio items, keyboard shortcuts, and classic drop shadow, built on Radix UI Context Menu.

items.name: retro-dialog
items.title: RetroDialog
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled modal dialog with overlay, OS9 window frame, striped title bar with close box, description area, and footer for action buttons, built on Radix UI Dialog.

items.name: retro-alert-dialog
items.title: RetroAlertDialog
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled alert dialog with OS9 window shadow, striped title bar, caution icon, and modal behavior, built on Radix UI Alert Dialog.

items.name: retro-toggle-group
items.title: RetroToggleGroup
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled toggle group with shared borders, raised/pressed bevel states, and single or multiple selection modes, built on Radix UI Toggle Group.

items.name: retro-table
items.title: RetroTable
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled data table with raised bevel column headers, hover highlight, azul selected row, and Finder list-view appearance.

items.name: retro-sheet
items.title: RetroSheet
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled sheet (slide-over panel) with side variants, striped title bar, close box, and overlay, built on Radix UI Dialog.

items.name: retro-scrollbar
items.title: RetroScrollbar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled scroll area with 16px wide/tall scrollbars featuring raised bevel thumb, inset track, and arrow navigation buttons at each end, built on Radix UI ScrollArea.

items.name: retro-navigation-menu
items.title: RetroNavigationMenu
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled navigation menu with horizontal strip, azul active triggers, dropdown content with classic drop shadow, and lavender hover links, built on Radix UI Navigation Menu.

items.name: retro-accordion
items.title: RetroAccordion
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled accordion with disclosure triangle, bevel separator, and collapse animation, built on Radix UI Accordion.

items.name: retro-collapsible
items.title: RetroCollapsible
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled collapsible disclosure with rotating triangle indicator, Charcoal heading trigger, and indented Geneva content area, built on Radix UI Collapsible.

items.name: retro-dropdown-menu
items.title: RetroDropdownMenu
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled dropdown menu with white background, classic drop shadow, azul-highlighted items, bevel separators, submenus, checkbox/radio items, and keyboard shortcut labels, built on Radix UI Dropdown Menu.

items.name: retro-theme-provider
items.title: NostalgiaProvider
items.description: A Mac OS 9 theme provider that injects all OS9 CSS variables and utility classes so consumers can use nostalgia-ui components without manual globals.css setup.

items.name: retro-typography
items.title: RetroText
items.description: A polymorphic Mac OS 9 text component with semantic variants matching the OS9 Figma type system: editorial (Apple Garamond 24pt), headline/smallHeadline (Charcoal), body/bodySmall/bodyBold/bodySlanted (Geneva), and mono (Monaco).

items.name: retro-toolbar
items.title: RetroToolbar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled toolbar with icon buttons, separators, and button groups. Includes RetroToolbar, RetroToolbarButton, RetroToolbarSeparator, and RetroToolbarGroup sub-components.

items.name: retro-aspect-ratio
items.title: RetroAspectRatio
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled aspect ratio container with optional inset border, built on Radix UI Aspect Ratio.

items.name: retro-spinner
items.title: RetroSpinner
items.description: Mac OS 9 styled loading indicators: RetroSpinner (animated wristwatch cursor with rotating second hand) and RetroBeachBall (spinning pinwheel wait cursor with colored segments). Both support sm/default/lg sizes via cva variants.

items.name: retro-carousel
items.title: RetroCarousel
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled carousel/slideshow with inset panel container, raised bevel navigation buttons with triangle arrow SVGs, and embla-carousel-react for smooth sliding. Supports horizontal and vertical orientations.

items.name: retro-input-otp
items.title: RetroInputOTP
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled one-time password input with individual inset bevel character slots, blinking caret, focus ring, and group separators, built on input-otp.

items.name: retro-resizable
items.title: RetroResizable
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled resizable panel group for split layouts with raised bevel handle, grip dots, and drag-darkening effect, built on react-resizable-panels.

items.name: retro-drawer
items.title: RetroDrawer
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled bottom sheet / drawer with pull handle, OS9 window bevel, and overlay, built on vaul.

items.name: retro-form
items.title: RetroForm
items.description: A React Hook Form integration with Mac OS 9 styling. Provides RetroForm, RetroFormField, RetroFormItem, RetroFormLabel, RetroFormControl, RetroFormDescription, and RetroFormMessage components following the shadcn Form pattern.

items.name: retro-command
items.title: RetroCommand
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled command palette (search interface) with inset search input, azul-highlighted items, keyboard shortcut labels, and modal dialog variant, built on cmdk and Radix UI Dialog.

items.name: retro-calendar
items.title: RetroCalendar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled date selection calendar grid with raised bevel navigation buttons, azul selected day, lavender hover and range states, built on react-day-picker v9.

items.name: retro-chart
items.title: RetroChart
items.description: Mac OS 9 styled charting components with Balloon Help tooltips, square legend indicators, inset bevel container, and Geneva typography, built on recharts. Provides RetroChartContainer, RetroChartTooltip, RetroChartTooltipContent, RetroChartLegend, RetroChartLegendContent, and RetroChartStyle.

items.name: retro-date-picker
items.title: RetroDatePicker
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled date picker with inline text input (MM/DD/YYYY), calendar icon trigger button, and popover calendar dropdown, composed from RetroPopover and RetroCalendar.

items.name: retro-date-range-picker
items.title: RetroDateRangePicker
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled date range picker with two inline text inputs, en-dash separator, calendar icon trigger, and a two-month popover calendar for range selection.

items.name: retro-combobox
items.title: RetroCombobox
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled searchable select / autocomplete combobox with inset bevel trigger, search input, azul-highlighted items, checkmark selection indicator, and group headings, built on Radix UI Popover.

items.name: retro-data-table
items.title: RetroDataTable
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled full-featured data table with column sorting, text filtering, pagination, row selection, and column visibility, built on @tanstack/react-table and existing RetroTable primitives.

items.name: retro-desktop
items.title: RetroDesktop
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled full-viewport desktop layout with pinned menu bar (Apple logo + live clock), desktop area with optional dot-pattern wallpaper, and selectable desktop shortcut icons with 32x32 icon area and Geneva 9px labels.

items.name: retro-sidebar
items.title: RetroSidebar
items.description: A Mac OS 9 styled app shell layout with collapsible sidebar, context-driven open/closed state, menu items with azul active and lavender hover, keyboard shortcut (Cmd+B) toggle, and icon-only collapsed mode. Provides RetroSidebarProvider, RetroSidebar, RetroSidebarHeader, RetroSidebarContent, RetroSidebarFooter, RetroSidebarMenu, RetroSidebarMenuItem, RetroSidebarMenuButton, RetroSidebarGroup, RetroSidebarGroupLabel, RetroSidebarTrigger, and RetroSidebarInset.

items.name: retro-icons
items.title: RetroIcons
items.description: Classic Mac OS 9 system icons as pure inline SVG components: Folder, Document, Trash, HardDrive, Floppy, Application, Alert, Info, Question, Stop, Network, Printer, Search, and Preferences. Includes a convenience RetroIcon wrapper with name prop and sm/default/lg/xl size variants.
